(1) racism is a key barrier to HIV testing among African American men and women, (2) racism is a complex phenomenon that operates at individual and structural levels, (3) racism is experienced through multiple pathways that are not necessarily mutually exclusive or additive, and (4) racism has both negative and positive effects on HIV testing.
